page_title: FIO 0-0 GEN | Fiorentina v Genoa 10/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Luca Massimi has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.

90+1' Dodo (Fiorentina) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) takes a mid-range free kick and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.

89' Luca Massimi blows his whistle for a foul after Wedtoin Latif Ouedraogo (Genoa) hacks down one of his opponents. Fiorentina win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
88' The statistic for corner kicks – 4:3. The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 11:13.
86' Paolo Vanoli has decided to make a change. Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) replaces Fabiano Parisi.
85' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Manor Solomon (Fiorentina).
84' Wedtoin Latif Ouedraogo (Genoa) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
82' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Amorim walks off the pitch to be replaced by Patrizio Masini (Genoa).
82' Here is a change. Alessandro Marcandalli is going off and Daniele De Rossi gives the last tactical orders to Mamedi Doucoure (Genoa).
79' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
74' Vitinha (Genoa) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
73' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) looks furious with himself after spurning a great chance. He pounces on the rebound around the penalty spot and drags a shot well wide of the right post.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Giovanni Fabbian (Fiorentina) will replace Cher Ndour.
72' Substitution. Rolando Mandragora is replaced by Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina).
71' It's time for a substitution. Wedtoin Latif Ouedraogo (Genoa) comes on in place of Aaron Martin.
71' Daniele De Rossi prepares a substitution. Jeff Ekhator is replaced by Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa).
71' Total attempts – 11:8. 0:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
70' A player from Genoa commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
69' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Luca Massimi signals. Genoa get a free kick.
66' The foul by Vitinha (Genoa) was seen by Luca Massimi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
65' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) collects a great pass, spins and releases a rocket of a shot from distance. Unluckily for him, it ends well wide of the left post.
65' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
62' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
61' Paolo Vanoli has decided to substitute Riccardo Braschi and he is replaced by Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina).
61' The referee awards a corner and Aaron Martin (Genoa) goes over to take it.
60' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) smashes a first-time shot a goal from inside the box, but it's bravely blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Genoa.
58' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick in order to find one of his teammates. His poor effort, however, sails way out of play.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) comes onto the pitch for Lorenzo Colombo.

57' Aaron Martin (Genoa) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Luca Massimi no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Fiorentina.
55' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

54' That didn't go as planned! Vitinha (Genoa) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past David de Gea, who easily kept it out.
53' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
52' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post.
52' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
51' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
50' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
49' Fiorentina are seeing far more of the ball now.
47' Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
46' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
46' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) has an effort from distance but it's blocked. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' This would have been a magnificent goal from Riccardo Braschi (Fiorentina), who collected the ball inside the box and prodded a first-time shot on goal that flew just narrowly wide of the right post.
44' Dodo (Fiorentina) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
42' Riccardo Braschi (Fiorentina) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
41' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
41' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Fiorentina force their opponents to concede a corner.
39' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the bottom right corner, but David de Gea keeps it out.
35' Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
32' 5:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 0:1.
31' Cher Ndour nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
29' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar.
29' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Luca Massimi blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Fiorentina.
28' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) strikes a volley towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders blocks his effort.
27' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
27' Dodo (Fiorentina) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

26' David de Gea doesn't have to worry about this one. Lorenzo Colombo plays a pass into the feet of Jeff Ekhator (Genoa), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the right post.
24' Amorim pings in the corner towards the centre of the box and finds Leo Ostigard (Genoa) unmarked, but his free header is woeful and slips well over the bar.
24' Amorim (Genoa) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
23' Aaron Martin (Genoa) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Genoa.
22' Dodo (Fiorentina) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Dodo (Fiorentina) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome.
19' Luca Massimi blows his whistle after Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Genoa) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
16' 56:44 – the latest ball possession ratio.
14' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) serves up a nice cross, but Justin Bijlow punches the ball away.
14' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
12' Vitinha (Genoa) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
10' Good defending. Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) tries to find Cher Ndour inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
7' A long pass finds Vitinha (Genoa), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the middle of the goal, but David de Gea reacts well to make a good save.
5' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
4' Dodo (Fiorentina) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Fiorentina earn a corner.
3' Genoa control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
2' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Amorim (Genoa) sends it out of play.
1' Riccardo Braschi (Fiorentina) is adjudged offside.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Genoa will have the kick-off.
Luca Massimi was nominated as the referee for this game.
